title: Motor Efficiency & IE Class Selection Pakistan 2026 — IE1/IE2/IE3/IE4, NEECA Regulations, Energy Audit & WAPDA Tariff ROI Buyer Guide
cluster: Industrial Motor Control & Drive Systems Pakistan — Day 1/3 (D128)
summary_html: Complete guide to motor efficiency class selection (IE1–IE4) in Pakistan 2026: NEECA MEPS SRO 612(I)/2022 compliance, PKR 2026 price table 0.37–315 kW, six-step motor energy audit, rewind-vs-replace decision framework, VFD vs capacitor correction ROI at LESCO/WAPDA B-2/C-2 tariffs, and 10-point motor selection checklist for Pakistani industrial buyers.
pakistan_differentiators: NEECA MEPS SRO 612(I)/2022 compliance mapping — IE2 minimum for regulated sectors, IE3 for captive power auxiliaries ≥18.5 kW
First PKR 2026 price table for IE2 vs IE3 motors from 0.37–315 kW with annual energy saving per motor at Pakistani B-2/C-2 tariff
Pakistan rewinding market tiers (EASA-affiliated vs bazaar-grade) with quantified efficiency loss and PKR annual cost impact at current tariff
Rewind-vs-replace decision rule calibrated to Pakistani industrial conditions (Rs 38/kWh blended, NEECA compliance)
Voltage unbalance analysis methodology for Pakistan distribution conditions (2–4% typical unbalance causing 1.5–2% extra losses)
Altitude derating for KPK/AJK/Islamabad-Murree corridor — rarely addressed for Pakistani buyers
SBP Green Banking + NEECA ESCO fund for motor replacement financing — first documented for Pakistani e-commerce
LESCO/DISCO starting approval threshold reminder for motors ≥18.5 kW (required before energisation)
